items.quote: Your app must use OAuth in order to be considered for Klaviyo’s App Marketplace.
items.why: Says OAuth required for marketplace; no api_key mention, not sufficient for both methods.

items.quote: For company-scoped apps, access tokens and refresh tokens grant access to a Klaviyo account.
items.why: Describes OAuth token access scope; consistent with oauth2, doesn't list methods.

items.quote: Private keys will have the prefix pk_ followed by a longer alphanumeric string.
items.why: States private key prefix pk_; supports api_key part only.

items.quote: Note that only owner, admin, and manager roles can create OAuth apps in Klaviyo.
items.why: Only owner/admin/manager can create OAuth apps; says nothing about free plan access.

items.quote: 500 emails per month to 250 active profiles
items.why: Gives free-tier-style email/profile limits; does not explicitly say a free plan exists or grants API access.

items.quote: All new API endpoints are rate limited on a per-account basis
items.why: Rate-limit sentence; says nothing about REST style, pagination, or scope groups.

items.quote: The Klaviyo Model Context Protocol (MCP) server seamlessly integrates with Klaviyo’s APIs,
items.why: Directly states Klaviyo's own MCP server exists; vendor-official implied by Klaviyo authorship.

items.quote: configure your MCP client for the remote-hosted server (recommended) or the local server
items.why: Implies remote and local MCP servers exist; configuration instruction only, no vendor-official statement.
